title: Verification
description: Evaluation outcome comparing a factual claim against retrieved evidence passages.

id.description: Unique UUID of the verification result

verdict.description: Verification verdict. Null if evidence is insufficient or retrieval failed.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the verification verdict

rationale.description: Transparent reasoning explaining how evidence supports or contradicts the claim

evidence_summary.description: Synthesized brief summary of key evidence points

needs_human_review.description: Flag indicating that human expert review is required

review_reasons.description: List of explicit reasons triggering human review

evaluated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when verification was executed
